title: Items and text display is clipped / wrongly show in diferent monitors resolutions
author: vansanper
body_snippet:

comments.author: robertpopa22
comments.snippet:
Thank you for the [#198-diag] lines. They show the confirmation checkbox left at the previous monitor's size. After the dialog settled at 96 DPI the checkbox was still at 192 DPI: an 8.25pt font drawn as 30px inside a 28 by 27 client, so the bottom of the box was clipped. Layout had only moved it.

The checkbox is now sized from the dialog DPI, and the glyph is painted inside the current client. That change is commit 63fe644b1 on main. It is not in nightly 20261001. The next nightly is what to r...

comments.author: robertpopa22
comments.snippet:
The mixed menu and dock fonts come from the menu keeping the font it was created with.

On the 2026-09-30 log the window moved from 96 to 192 DPI. The dock panel followed, at 8.25pt and 30px. The menu stayed at 16px. That same 16px line was logged as 4.5pt because a font that is not stored in points is measured against the screen, and the screen was at 192 DPI. On .NET 10 the menu is told the old and new DPI are equal, so it does not take a new font. Upstream records that behavior as dotnet/winf...

notes: 2026-10-02: checkbox fit is 63fe644b1 and is not in nightly 20261001. Chrome whose line spacing does not follow the dock panel is rebuilt from that panel in 2eb2e5ca6. The log records font unit, raw size, and line spacing at the window DPI. A two-monitor session was not driven. Public comment https://github.com/robertpopa22/mRemoteNG/issues/198#issuecomment-5947037314 names that commit. The issue stays open.
